headline: Brazilian Real Surges Past R$5.44, Posting Largest Weekly Gain Since 2008
summary: The US dollar rose to R$5.44 against the Brazilian real, marking its highest quote of 2026 and a weekly surge of over 9% in the post-election environment.
why: Currency depreciation against the US dollar influences domestic inflation, import costs, and monetary policy decisions by the central bank.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Brazilian Real
impacts.why: The greenback strengthens directly against the real amid post-election currency flows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Post-election market uncertainty drove heavy capital flows out of local assets and into foreign exchange.
